testEnvironment: Actual migration CLI, registry operations and index builders run in temporary v2/v3 workspaces. Explicit maps are previewed and then applied to initialized records, with shared navigation rebuilt. Preserved sources, manifest, asset bytes, identities, bindings, unrelated relationships and retained owner annotations are checked. Link targets are separate temporary directories outside the test workspace. Fixed clock and atomic rename failure hooks run only in isolated child processes; rollback compares original descriptor bytes and retry verifies lock release.
